reason: A DSH settings-sidebar plugin for listing, importing, enabling, disabling, validating, and repairing local skills across system and project scopes.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置侧边栏中管理本地 Skill，支持查看、批量导入、启用停用、规范检查与自动修复。
summaries.en: A DSH settings-sidebar plugin for managing local skills through listing, batch import, enable/disable controls, validation, and automatic metadata repair.

capabilities: Reads local DSH skill directories and project skill locations
Writes, moves, imports, and replaces skill files within configured DSH skill directories
Validates and automatically repairs skill metadata and naming
Provides a local HTTP API for skill listing and management
Displays skill status and scope information in a settings sidebar panel
